capability_statement: AOF can replay an external session contract against session evidence and show whether confidence increased, decreased, stayed unchanged, or must be escalated.
before_state: External session contracts could be mentioned in release notes, but AOF did not audit how the result changed session tool authority.
after_state: AOF records session contract, confidence before/after, replay steps, governance route, no-write boundary, and not-proven limits in one audit chain.
scenario: A reviewer says the v11.2 GitHub read is only partially validated; inspect the replay record and audit to see how AOF treats that result without overclaiming it.
five_minute_demo: Open SESS-V114-AGENT-SESSION-TOOL-GOVERNANCE.json and agent-session-contract-audit.json; confirm prompt/response/tool-call evidence, tool-governance status, governance route, and zero hidden write authority.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes manual argument about whether a session contract supports, blocks, or weakens the session-evidence claim.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer has to infer whether partial or conflicting validation was hidden; the route is explicit.

capability_matrix.before: session contract was prose-only or release-note-only evidence
capability_matrix.after: session contract is replayed into confidence and governance routing
capability_matrix.user_value: operator can see what changed in confidence and whether uncertainty was escalated

not_proven: This does not prove provider semantic truth, actual independent third-party validation, GitHub write safety, credential safety, production automation, market value, productivity gain, or broad adoption.
